name: Murder Mindfully
description: When mafia lawyer Björn attends a mindfulness class to find a better work-life balance, he discovers surprising new coping strategies — including murder.

videos.title: Breathing
videos.overview: After taking mindfulness lessons, defense lawyer Björn finds a new way to deal with his main client: a violent crime boss who demands too much of him.

videos.title: Happiness
videos.overview: Björn figures out how to mindfully dispose of a body while navigating the suspicions of his family, the police and Dragan's underlings.

videos.title: Fear
videos.overview: As he gets back to his routine to avoid any appearance of guilt, Björn discovers a couple of loose ends he needs to deal with.

videos.title: Shamelessness
videos.overview: Katharina asks for Björn's help in securing a day care center for Emily. Toni suspects Björn isn't being truthful about Dragan's whereabouts.

videos.title: Panic
videos.overview: Nicole investigates a series of explosive clues. After being kidnapped by a rival crime boss, Björn sets out to expose Toni's plan.

videos.title: Brainstorming
videos.overview: It would be easier to just murder everyone, but Björn decides on a more practical solution. Nicole questions Emily about her trip to the lake.

videos.title: Anger
videos.overview: Caught between Toni and the police, Björn looks for a way to kill two birds with one stone. Boris makes a final demand to see Dragan.

videos.title: Death
videos.overview: Björn enacts a risky plan to deal with Boris and get Nicole off his back, and it's important to be mindful of every detail.

videos.title: Vacation
videos.overview: Nicole runs into trouble with her evidence. On a family vacation in Austria, Björn tries to relax — but one serious slip shows he still has work to do.

videos.title: Reality
videos.overview: Björn stages a day care break-in to deal with yet another problem. A chilling message and a surprise visit from the parents' group complicate things.

videos.title: Parents
videos.overview: The parents' group pushes to inspect the basement. Disturbed in his sleep, Björn's inner child nudges him to deal with the teens across the street.

videos.title: Creativity
videos.overview: Björn agrees to meet with Laura's brother Kurt. As the blackmail escalates, his creative plan for the Holgerson hostages takes a dark turn.

videos.title: Knowledge
videos.overview: When Björn learns about Kurt's past, he grows suspicious. With Kurt, Nicole, pushy parents and a tricky delivery, he's got a lot on his mind.

videos.title: Mistake
videos.overview: Nicole shows interest in Kurt and questions the "coincidences" in the Holgerson story. Meanwhile, Björn comes up with yet another explosive plan.

videos.title: Doubt
videos.overview: Björn enjoys a false sense of security, but the Holgersons come knocking and he makes a risky promise. Sascha plots to keep the parents in check.

videos.title: Morality
videos.overview: Björn makes Kurt an offer he can't refuse... or can he? As things get ugly in the basement, staying calm is Björn's last defense against chaos.
